_doc: SPEC-V2: the voice surface. 'What doctors are there?' → clinic_clinicians. 'Anything after nine with Dr X?' → clinic_find_slots. Every refusal is a sentence an agent can read aloud.
An open-ended search matches the whole open board.
A window that excludes everything names the killing constraint — the agent can say WHICH filter to relax.
A clinician nobody has is named as the constraint, and the live ids still come back.
Gibberish time is refused loudly with how to say it, never silently unfiltered.
SPEC-V4: with nothing booked, prepare_cancel does not EXIST — the human's press is what creates it.
